title: Reducing nitrobenzene to phenylamine
caption: Tin and concentrated hydrochloric acid reduce the nitro group to –NH₂ (as the phenylammonium salt; adding NaOH frees the amine). Phenylamine is the starting point for azo dyes.
alt: Nitrobenzene, an arrow labelled Sn / conc. HCl then NaOH, and phenylamine.
